items.name: 전투 배경 — 평원
items.prompt: Open green grassland under a bright blue sky, distant rolling hills, a few wildflowers. Moody, richly painted HD pixel-art battlefield in a modern indie 2D game style, slightly dark and atmospheric. Layered depth: distant scenery and tree line in the top third, a mid layer of bushes, rocks, ruins or fences along the horizon, and a wide, FLAT, open, walkable ground area in the lower two thirds seen from a slight high angle (textured soil, scattered grass tufts and small stones, a faint dirt path). Keep the center of the ground calm and low-contrast so small character sprites stay readable; put denser foliage only near the left and right edges. Pixel art background in a 16-bit fantasy JRPG style, limited palette (about 48 colors), clean pixel clusters, no anti-aliasing, no text, no watermark, no UI, NO characters or creatures.
